svg.title: Guest tools
svg.desc: Guest tools: they come in for one question, they do not move in. At the door, six checks are ticked one by one: address typed, not searched; archive hash checked; nothing extra in the zip; signer's name read out; licence fits the place; no installer, no driver. Then the guest list, on visitor badges: WinDirStat (open source), which folders fill the disk; Sysinternals du (Microsoft), the same but can only measure; Autoruns (Microsoft), what really starts at boot; CrystalDiskInfo (open source), raw disk health figures. Used, deleted, written in the journal. Built-in tools first; free-for-personal-use tools stay out of the office. A rejected archive falls down the shaft.
